risk_flags.description: The admission note states no prior history of diabetes and new onset, while the discharge summary states a 10-year history. This is an internal conflict.

specialist_trace.rationale: The documentation must be reconciled to establish a single, definitive duration of diabetes, as the conflicting statements (new onset vs. 10-year history) directly affect the clinical picture and coding accuracy. Additionally, specify the type of diabetes management (e.g., insulin-dependent vs. non-insulin-dependent) and provide objective glycemic control data, such as recent HbA1c values, to clarify severity and guide appropriate code selection. Without these clarifications, the record remains ambiguous for accurate clinical coding.
